title: Serpent's Awakening
description: A colossal skeletal serpent with glowing orange eyes and open jaws emerges from swirling purple smoke, positioned at the center of glowing concentric green and yellow rings. In the foreground, a small female figure in a white dress stands with one arm raised, facing the massive creature within a dark, ruined architectural space filled with floating embers.
prompt: A massive skeletal serpent with glowing orange eyes and fiery breath bursts forth from swirling purple mist and concentric glowing green and yellow magical rings. In the foreground a small woman in a flowing white dress stands with one arm raised toward the creature. Dark ruined architecture and floating orange embers fill the scene, dramatic fantasy atmosphere, cinematic lighting, detailed digital painting.
